text_simplified: Parents must teach their children the rights of parents and al-birr (birr al-walidayn) towards them, while emphasizing the importance of salah, truthfulness, and ihsan. Children should also be guided to obey Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, and to avoid lying and cheating.
